purpose: The subject-level (occupation-level) salary layer used by the Study-to-Career Strategist. ONLY cells verified against a primary official statistics source (verification == PRIMARY_VERIFIED in research_raw/_global/002-005) are stored here. PENDING and GAP cells are deliberately absent so the strategist renders 'Insufficient data' for them rather than reaching for a country average. This is separate from the production country corpus and from the reviewed TOPIC_PATHS ingest path; promoting it into corpus is a deferred, reviewed change (see docs/strategist/RESEARCH_REPORT.md section 9).
basis_rule: Every value is GROSS, whole-occupation/-class, all experience levels. basis==gross is enforced at load: a net value is refused. None of these is entry-level, degree-specific, take-home, stipend, scholarship, tuition or living cost, and they are never merged with those.
granularity: Each entry records whether it is a single occupation or an occupation-CLASS median so a class figure is never read as one role.
